servers.description: Local development; use HTTPS in production

get.description: Configured routes, limits, retentionMs, and analysis processing location/consent. Configuration does not guarantee model health.

post.description: Explicit opt-in development only; forbidden in production.
JPEG/PNG/WebP up to 5 MiB and 20 MP; normalized to at most 1024 px. A deduplicated upload returns 200.
Same user/key/request returns the same job for 24 hours; conflicting requests return 409. Palette version is frozen on creation.

get.description: Execution success and generation quality are separate states.

post.description: Idempotent; terminal jobs keep their state.

get.description: Best-effort exports require explicit acceptance; no-valid-candidate has no export.

automaticMatch.description: False excludes this material from automatic matching, not from physical bead counts.

grid.description: Row-major palette indices; -1 means empty board space.

contourPlan.description: Cell paths, physical colors, final retention/contrast diagnostics and warnings.

canvas.description: Fixed width and height must match.

valueMode.description: Default: faithful=preserve, simple=adaptive, other styles=stylized. Outlines are independent.

valueStrength.description: Zero bypasses tonal changes; preserve always uses zero.

external.description: Defaults on; legacy outlineMode=off disables unless explicitly overridden.

internal.description: Defaults on; requires distinct semantic regions.

colorId.description: Optional physical palette ID. Omit for bounded automatic contrast.
